REPRODUCIBLE ANALYSIS

The decision has an audit trail.

Python generates deterministic user journeys and validates funnel order. SQLite applies indexed segment queries. A two-proportion z-test turns the experiment result into a documented ship or hold decision.

  • 30,000 users generated with a fixed seed
  • 24 precomputed channel and platform segments
  • 3 indexes verified with query plans
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS signed_up,
  SUM(completed_onboarding) AS onboarded,
  SUM(activated) AS activated,
  SUM(subscribed) AS subscribed
FROM user_journeys;
